denominatorPolicy.construction: Questions are operationalized from this holdout's independent audit and assigned once to their primary pre-registered closure dimension. N/A items are recorded but excluded from recall. Broad thematic resemblance does not count as recall.

items.finding: V0 requires scope-limited identity/proof objects, so it recovers the need to keep the masked presenter, 人类最强编导 label, 雷子酱编导 sign-off, and Xiaohongshu platform identity separate.
The visible high-status label is an identity/attitude symbol, not proof of legal identity, account ownership, or ability.
A single argumentative post does not establish the account's sustained audience promise or supply system.
V0 recovers the addressed creator audience and the post's proposed problem: over-weighting tactical packaging while under-specifying core expression.
Youth uncertainty, gendered unfairness, and national memory are recognizable demand/identity-conflict hypotheses under P04's common-emotion mechanism.
V0 prevents treating a few cases or comments as proof that all humans, all women, or all identities share one response.
The post's observable job is viewpoint persuasion/authority building; it is not an operational tutorial or demonstrated production result.
No account-level portfolio plan or pre-registered guard task is present in the source.
V0 recovers the novelty hook, contrastive thesis, and roadmap as an opening contract with an evidence responsibility.
The three examples deliver illustrations for the promised thesis, but their screenshots and stories must be evaluated within their limited proof scope.
The ending closes rhetorically by strengthening the opening, but 'data follow naturally' is not evidence that the opening result was validated.
V0's mechanism and cognitive-node requirements recover the three cases as parallel argumentative supports, not a sequential production process.
It recovers the case-to-principle generalization as a mechanism hypothesis that still needs counterexamples, reconstruction, and testing.
V0 correctly bounds the search pages and captured counters: they show topic/post states, not the narrated aggregate scale, participation count, attribution, or causal explanation.
The upgrades '必然爆款' and '顺其自然' remain author claims; V0 explicitly treats common emotion and public performance as hypotheses, not causal proof.
V0 asks for conditions, counterexamples, unknowns, and controlled alternatives, preventing universalization across age, gender, identity, or niche.
Historical, literary, sociological, and source-work details require external sourcing; narration alone does not verify them.
V0 assigns the presenter speech to explanation/judgment and the inserted UI to limited visual proof instead of mechanically treating them as equivalent evidence.
P09 directly requires preserving speech/subtitle/OCR conflicts rather than silently normalizing 骈文/篇文, 时期/时机, 发声/发生, and proper names.
V0 lacks an explicit referent ledger for nested example assets: '一张图片一段BGM' belongs to the Lila example and must not be auto-bound to this video's soundtrack.
P09 and closure item 9 enumerate image/speech/subtitle functions but do not require inspection or unresolved status for meaning-bearing non-speech audio.
Meaningful shot-function and keep/compress/remove requirements prevent converting ten technical shots into ten semantic scenes.
The spoken ending is only identity plus farewell; P05 specifically says '下期见' is not a follow contract or series handoff without a next object/progress/problem.
V0 does not specify carrier-scoped negative-evidence rules, so it cannot by itself distinguish 'no spoken CTA' from 'no CTA anywhere' when visuals were sampled rather than exhaustively inspected.
Public interaction counts can describe captured performance but cannot establish that empathy caused it; the claim must become a pre-registered experiment.
The source supplies no publishing experiment, controlled variants, review window, failure line, or next iteration to reconstruct.
The inserted search-result pages are evidence objects; they do not establish that this post itself has a search-versus-homepage distribution task.
The visible @莫那手绘 label and engagement snapshot do not establish drawing authorship, work identity, original context, metric date, or authorization chain.
The Spider-Man-like mask and creator labels trigger identity/IP authorization checks without asserting infringement or affiliation.
V0's proof-scope and unknown fields keep unverified scale, source, attribution, identity, universality, and causality unresolved.
No commercial offer, purchase instruction, health claim, or dangerous procedure appears; commercial/health/safety transaction gates are N/A beyond source and identity rights.

falsePositiveAudit.finding: No V0 clause was credited by inventing an account promise, portfolio role, publication experiment, search-distribution task, or commercial/safety workflow absent from the holdout.

criticalRecall.definition: proof, causal, attribution/rights, identity, and safety-scope questions

deltaFindings.finding: The holdout independently instantiates shared emotion as a useful topic mechanism while also showing why it must remain a hypothesis rather than an exhaustive law.
The exact weak handoff predicted by V0 appears: '下期再见' closes the video but specifies no next object, progress, variant, or unresolved problem.
A rhetorically closed opening/ending can still be causally unproven; screenshots and public metrics do not discharge the proof responsibility.
The carrier contract is too narrow: it should explicitly include non-speech audio and require unresolved status when its semantic role cannot be established.
Nested-example referent closure is absent: an image/BGM mentioned inside a case must be bound to that case and kept separate from the enclosing video's own soundtrack and rights chain.
Carrier-scoped absence claims are absent: complete transcript absence, representative-frame absence, and full-timeline visual absence require different wording and confidence.
None. The author's universal/causal assertions are unverified claims, not evidence that contradicts V0.
Whether shared-emotion framing improves virality or downstream trust remains unresolved because the holdout contains examples without controlled comparisons, failed cases, or causal identification.

originalAction.name: 共同情感开场的配对流量实验
originalAction.originality: Uses the holdout's emotional-memory thesis as one controlled creative variable rather than copying any of its three examples, mask, slogans, or cases.
originalAction.audience: 22–30岁、担心被AI替代的初级内容从业者
originalAction.asset: 制作一条45秒原创视频：用一份带日期的真实任务返工记录说明‘第一次怀疑自己会被时代淘汰’的具体时刻，并给出一个可执行的技能盘点动作。

variants.A: 前5秒用共同情感记忆开场：‘我们第一次害怕被时代淘汰，往往不是失业那天，而是发现旧本事突然不值钱。’
variants.B: 前5秒用工具利益开场：‘用这3栏表，10分钟找出你最不容易被AI替代的能力。’

originalAction.allocation: 若平台支持创意A/B，则50:50随机分流；否则做两轮交叉时段复测并将分发差异列为混杂项。
originalAction.primaryMetric: 每1000个5秒有效观看带来的主页访问后关注数
originalAction.window: 每版至少5000次曝光且满72小时；任一条件未到则继续观察但不宣判。
originalAction.successRule: A相对B的主指标提升至少15%，且误解/反感评论率不增加超过2个百分点、取关率不劣化超过0.2个百分点；否则不把共同情感开场升级为规则。
originalAction.failureAction: 若主指标未达线，保留主体证明材料，只把下一轮变量改为情感主张的范围限定句，不同时改标题、画面或CTA。

hypothesisGates.finding: Final independent evaluation-v2 reports READY_FOR_DOWNSTREAM_USE and deterministic ready=true with 22/22 passing gates.
Three genuine misses are retained: nested asset referents, non-speech audio semantics, and carrier-scoped negative evidence.
All critical proof, causal, identity/attribution, rights, and safety-scope questions are recalled.
The four strong outcome families—80亿 scale, 数以万计/亿万女性, cross-identity universality, and empathy=>virality—remain assertions or unknowns.
Account promise, portfolio role, publishing/review workflow, search-distribution role, and commercial/health transaction gates are not hard-applied.
The report includes confirmations, limitations, novelties, an explicit no-contradiction result, and unresolved causal status.
A controlled, original paired-traffic experiment is specified with constants, allocation, metrics, window, success line, guards, and failure action.

verdict.label: PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS
verdict.summary: V0 generalizes to this argumentative emotional-memory video at 23/26 applicable closure questions (88.46%) with 10/10 critical recall, zero causal upgrades, and correct N/A handling. The real gaps are carrier/referent audit precision, not the central directing model.
